{{Quote|You promised to help us. In exchange for our aid you swore to destroy the ancient evils of our Rakata ancestors! Are you saying this means nothing to you now?|The Rakata, to Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
This '''Elder Rakatan''' was a red [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] and a member of the [[Elder Council]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. This Rakata was a leading member of the Elder tribe along with two other Rakatans and made a deal with [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] before the war.
